text:
Leah: Heads-up — Silverline just told their platform lead they will spin up 3 new automation squads next month. each squad will run embedding-heavy pipelines (search + dedupe). Asking for guidance on capacity + onboarding timeline.

Aisha: Nice, do we have rough qps/throughput numbers from them? renewal in 8 weeks so this is time-sensitive. :eyes:

Leah: They expect steady-state ~600 qps embeddings (all small vectors) and short spikes to ~1.2k qps during nightly reindex. Current usage is ~40 qps.

Tom: Oof. That's ~15-30x. We should propose a Dedicated pilot or Recommend batching+cache config immediately. Can we get an eval dataset to estimate cost?

Ravi: If it's embeddings-heavy, quantized model on dedicated pools + larger batch windows will help. Also prefix/KV cache won't help embeddings, but sharded-rps routing and pre-warmed pods will.

Leah: Customer is sensitive to latency — search must be <120ms p95. They said they'll consider switching vendors at renewal if latency degrades.

Eve: I can pre-warm pods and set up autoscale policies but need an expected connection pattern (burst length, duration). Can we lock a ramp plan?

Aisha: I'll pull the usage pattern from their telemetry and ask for a 2-week pilot start date. Proposed immediate ask: reserve 4 dedicated GPUs for a pilot, with autoscale to 12 during spikes.

Tom: From infra side that seems doable. Quick checklist for ops:
```
- reserve 4x A10/dedicated-pool
- create routing policy: route embeddings->quantized-v2
- set autoscale policy: min=4 max=12 scale-window=60s
- prewarm cache: prewarm_kv=false (embeddings)
```

Ravi: Also recommend prompt/template changes client-side to batch requests into 64-item calls where possible. We'll send a small SDK example.

Leah: Can someone draft the enablement note for the customer? Need steps, expected latency, cost estimate, and rollback plan.

Tom: I'll drop a short runbook and cost estimate. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/silverline-embed-ramp (internal)

Eve: Prewarming job queued. deploy-bot: can you create the capacity ticket?

deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-4729 created for Dedicated pool provisioning. ETA: 48h for first allocation. :white_check_mark:

Aisha: Great. Leah — I'll sync with the customer and get their sample payloads. Ravi/Tom/Eve — expect a short handoff call tomorrow 10:30am PT.

Leah: Thanks team. Priority: high (renewal risk). Follow-ups: Aisha to collect telemetry + payloads, Tom to prepare runbook & cost, Eve to queue prewarm, Ravi to produce SDK batching example.

Tom: ack. I'll post the runbook draft in this thread once ready. :thumbsup:

Ravi: I'll attach the batching snippet here after the call.

Leah: 👍 closing loop for now. If anyone sees anything blocking, ping me.
